title: Finite bit construction: compose R439 A/B/star D to 10,652 ADDs
body:
The frozen PR1062 B/star-D word costs 11,500 ADDs. Composing PR980's A preparation and rebuilding literal cleanup reduces it to **10,652**, a fully paid saving of **848** and **13,653 below PR589**. This is a **finite bit-circuit construction, with no new kappa**.

All eight combinations of the frozen A, B and D changes are retained and independently checked. The full composition reduces conservative positive bounds to **F = 15,223 and B = 3,910,388**, giving **92 local / 176 nine-stage bits** within the inherited 104/192 ceilings. D alone implements the right F2 map but requires 193 nine-stage bits and is rejected; either A or B makes that D admissible.

The contribution also closes PR1062's stated missing native check: its exact 11,500-ADD word is one of the eight freshly replayed corners. PR980's headline 872 saving includes 24 B/cleanup ADDs already covered by PR1062, so only 848 are additional; the verifier rejects the double-counted 10,628 invoice.

## Reproduce and evidence

```sh
python3 -I -B research/r439-abc-star-composition/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/r439-abc-star-composition/test_package.py -v
```

C++17 and Boost headers are required for native replay; `BOOST_INCLUDE` and `CXX` support nonstandard installations. Expected marker: `PASS_R439_ABC_STAR_COMPOSITION`.

- All 661 independent dirty input columns, phase maps and complete literal ADD/COPY/ERASE streams, forward and backward, for all eight words.
- Unchanged owning E8/frame checker and fresh native 5/9/11-stage checks: 883/1,327/1,549 physical columns per word; **384 omitted-bridge controls** rejected.
- Every register's ordered MOVE path, paid histogram/rank mass 5,129, nine rank-seven copies and all helper counts preserved. Complete scalar/bridge and precision bills checked separately.
- **17 semantic/accounting controls, 10 package tests and 14 existing selected-record/finite-contract tests** pass. Strict source pins and complete decoded gzip comparison.
- Linux CPython 3.14.4 and isolated optimized 3.12.3 from a relocated read-only tree produce byte-identical complete receipts. GCC 15.2.0 / Boost 1.83.0. The first driver attempt misread the reverse-stage COPY subtotal; the corrected totals are checked in both final replays, without changing a source checker.

## Scope and provenance

Only `research/r439-abc-star-composition/` is added. Base **ba82555c64e1879e4b7decce28186f208fcb8262**; OS assignment seed **13**, bit track. Domain: exactly eight fixed combinations, no new synthesis or search restarts. Twenty-two source/context files have exact Git-object and SHA-256 pins. Pending PR1062 is frozen at **cd016e5dcd5ba28dafa3f3b4eeef003a38e6a11b**. Upstream/source pins were refreshed, and overlap checked through #1120; #1113 concerns a different historical matching neighborhood.

The changed D inherits **false syntactic H2 and literal K_equals_D**. Those original predicates remain intact; semantic D equality is checked separately. Adoption still needs acceptance of that interface, full hosted-supplier emission/audit, complete finite/precision bindings and outer assembly. All-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, hosting, precision/tape, recovery and analytic obligations remain. The paid profile is unchanged. No full repository suite, selected complex cold replay, hosted CI success, unrestricted optimum or full formal multiplication theorem is claimed.

Credit Gareth Davidson PR904/915/926/952/980, Ross Richardson PR936/923, Aaron Wang PR1015, Sricharan Vagvala PR967, and **Sagar Thakrar PR1062**, plus DreamingOfClouds PR589 on eumemic PR555/543 and the retained native-checker lineage. Source notices and AI disclosures are preserved. Prepared by **Gareth Davidson (@bitplane)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**; new material Apache-2.0.
